usage: 瀏覽器 (browser) is a noun that refers to software used to access information on the internet.
You can use the word 瀏覽器 to specify different types of web browsers, like Chrome or Safari.
瀏覽器 often appears as the subject or object in sentences related to internet use.
It is common to combine 瀏覽器 with verbs like 開 (open), 用 (use), or 更新 (update).
In everyday conversation, 瀏覽器 is used when talking about surfing the web or changing browser settings.
